GRADING SERVICE

Gemini, at your pace.

The grading service is shared across visitors. Your answers are queued safely when another attempt is being assessed.

The site owner configures the Gemini connection on the server. Students do not need to enter a key. Instant SQL and numerical checks are available independently.

When you request Gemini grading, your answers and relevant questions are processed by the website’s Render server and sent to Google. Google’s free-tier data terms apply. Drafts and results stay in this browser; grading jobs are held temporarily by the server. Do not enter confidential workplace data.
